ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels to 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupying the lateral lobes; a central low-intensity black vertical band expanding at the base; low-intensity black distal margins and focal mottling at the outer tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior convergence angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve fitted to the trailing edge boundary from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark pixel clusters localized at the distal tips; scattered circular low-intensity spots on the interior white surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One vertical hook-shaped dark mark on the mid-left lobe; two parallel vertical dark marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear pigmentation breaks on both lobes; irregular erosive topography on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical butterfly-shaped black pigmentation pattern centered around the median notch.
